source: Fresh independent Codex review of the prefix-state correction.
problem: The event mapper renders a capped status move as |-boost|...|0 even when the engine emitted no Boost instruction. Python treated that presentation-only zero as a state-changing event, required legal_roll_state, and falsely skipped a later opponent hit.
required_mechanism: Treat |-boost| and |-unboost| as state-changing only when their rendered stage amount is nonzero.
Treat a malformed stat-event amount conservatively as state-changing so the branch remains fail-closed.
regression_prediction: A capped Swords Dance rendering |-boost|...|0 before an opponent Tackle must not load a branch-local state or raise BranchLegalRollError.
containment: Do not change the Rust prefix snapshot mechanism.
Do not relax handling of actual nonzero boosts or unboosts.
Do not widen accepted damage supports, attribution, residual handling, or divergence classes.
